system.description:
You tear two large chunks of stones from the ground using the strength of your chakra alone, hurling them at different spaces. Select two points you can see in range. All creatures within 10 feet of the chosen points must make a Strength saving throw as you hurl two large boulders at them. The affected areas become difficult terrain as the stones crush the ground.

On a failed save, affected creatures take 2d6 earth damage and become Bruised or half as much on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, select one additional point for this jutsu to affect. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the radius of the affected area to 15-feet. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher select one additional point for this jutsu to affect.. When this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the affected area to 20-feet.
